title: Hong Kong antimicrobial wholesale supply
provider: Department of Health, Hong Kong SAR Government / Drug Office
unit_of_observation: Year × supply recipient sector × antimicrobial group

terms.copyright: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
terms.status: No open data licence inferred from the checked CHP page
terms.scope: Factual numeric values are extracted with attribution; original HTML/PDF remain linked rather than redistributed. CHP copyright permission explicitly covers complete, unmodified copies for personal/internal use. Public reuse permission for the table compilation is not established. Source material is outside the application MIT licence.

dictionary.year: Annual survey/statistical year; no artificial observation date is assigned.
dictionary.sector: Original supply recipient sector. Total is the published human-use aggregate; veterinary surgeons and farmers are excluded from this aggregate.
dictionary.antimicrobial_group: Original broad pharmacological group or All antimicrobials. Six selected classes are supplied per detailed sector table; their sum is not the full sector total.
dictionary.measure: Wholesale supply reported by licensed wholesalers; an indirect use indicator, not a dispensing, prescribing or consumption measurement.
dictionary.value: Original reported numeric value; no recomputation from rounded sector rows.
dictionary.unit: DID = defined daily doses per 1,000 inhabitants per day. DDD is a technical unit and does not equal a prescribed dose.
dictionary.human_use_flag: False for Veterinary surgeons. True for the six human sectors and the published human Total. Never sum human Total with its component sectors.
dictionary.provisional: True only for years explicitly marked provisional by the source footnotes.
dictionary.raw_cell: Source text retains its decimal precision; a printed 0.000 is a reported rounded value, not a missing value or proof of absence.
dictionary.source_table/source_row/source_column: 1-based HTML table, row (including header), and column, respectively.
dictionary.aggregation_level: human_total, sector_total, or sector_drug_group. Totals and detail groups overlap and must not be added together.
dictionary.value_status: reported or not_reported. Missing tokens stay null and are never replaced by zero.

notes: This snapshot uses only the current HTML tables; historical report values are not spliced into it.
The December 2025 report gives 2024 total as 18.33 DID (PDF page 4); this HTML snapshot reports 18.34 DID. Keep the source version attached.
Quinolone antibacterials are a drug class. A comparison with PHLSB levofloxacin resistance is annual background comparison with different endpoints.

audit.processing: All six tables unpivoted without interpolation, normalization or imputation. Original decimal cells and table positions retained.
